name: samebase-monorepo
description: Samebase monorepo with PNPM and Vite+ tooling

scripts.check: pnpm run check:workspace && pnpm run check:root
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run check:workspace:ci && pnpm run check:root
scripts.check:plugin: vp fmt --check packages/plugin && node scripts/check-samebase-agent-plugin.ts && node scripts/check-agent-plugin-logo.ts
scripts.check:packages: pnpm run check:plugin && pnpm --filter @samebase/sure check && pnpm --filter @samebase/dependent check && pnpm --filter @samebase/logo-model check && pnpm --filter @samebase/sidebars check && pnpm --filter @samebase/onboarding-video-tools check
scripts.check:remotion-studio: pnpm run typecheck:remotion-studio && pnpm run lint:remotion-studio
scripts.check:workspace: vp run --filter samebase check && pnpm run check:packages && pnpm run check:remotion-studio
scripts.check:workspace:ci: vp run --filter samebase check:ci && pnpm run check:packages && pnpm run check:remotion-studio
scripts.check:scripts: pnpm run check:git-blob-sizes && pnpm run typecheck:scripts && pnpm run warn:tracked-file-paths && pnpm run lint:scripts && pnpm run verify:template-export && pnpm run check:agents-budget
scripts.audit:supply-chain: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm run audit:signatures && pnpm run audit:vulnerabilities
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter samebase typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run typecheck:remotion-studio && pnpm typecheck:scripts
scripts.typecheck:packages: pnpm --filter @samebase/sure typecheck && pnpm --filter @samebase/dependent typecheck && pnpm --filter @samebase/logo-model typecheck && pnpm --filter @samebase/sidebars typecheck && pnpm --filter @samebase/onboarding-video-tools typecheck
scripts.ci:convex-bootstrap: CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous pnpm --filter samebase exec convex dev --until-success --typecheck=disable --tail-logs=disable
scripts.clean: rm -rf .turbo .vite coverage test-results apps/samebase/dist apps/samebase/dev-dist apps/samebase/e2e/test-results apps/samebase/e2e/live-test-results
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test && PLAYWRIGHT_VITE_PORT=43121 pnpm --filter samebase test:visual
scripts.lint:scripts: pnpm exec vp lint --tsconfig tsconfig.scripts.json --report-unused-disable-directives runtime scripts packages/plugin/scripts .devcontainer/postcreate.ts apps/samebase/scripts apps/samebase/postcss.config.ts apps/samebase/tailwind.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:scripts: pnpm run generate:tracked-file-paths && tsgo -p tsconfig.scripts.json --pretty false
